data.name: AgroCCS
data.description: AgroCCS B.V. is a Dutch biochar project developer running pyrolysis-based carbon removal projects in the Global South, starting with Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India, with additional sites listed in Kenya, Guinea, Burundi, Uzbekistan, and Chandauli. The company sells CO2 removal credits under the Puro.earth standard and is currently pre-selling CORCs to early buyers while the Varanasi project remains in early development.
